name: Blanche of Castile
contribution: Queen of France by marriage to Louis VIII.
legacy: This person is considered one of the most successful and influential French queens, and one of the most capable medieval rulers as a whole

checks.lead: Blanche of Castile (Spanish: Blanca de Castilla; French: Blanche de Castille; 4 March 1188 – 27 November 1252) was Queen of France by marriage to Louis VIII. Blanche supported Louis' invasion to become King of England in her name, providing reinforcements. After her husband's death, she was appointed as sole regent according to Louis VIII's will. She acted as regent twice during the reign of her son, Louis IX: during his minority from 1226 until 1234, and during his absence from 1248 until 1252.
